interim_looks.stopping_action: Early stopping permitted ONLY for overwhelming early superiority (Z >= 2.96, nominal p < 0.0015). If candidate recall drops by > 2*delta (Delta R < -0.10), suspend shadow testing for model defect analysis.
Evaluate futility. If candidate recall is significantly inferior or if Delta R < -0.10, terminate candidate testing. Early promotion permitted if Z >= 2.14.
Confirmatory non-inferiority evaluation submitted to Model Risk Committee. Promotion requires Z >= 1.71 (nominal p < 0.0440) alongside operational criteria.

statistical_design_verification.critical_distinction: Nominal boundary p-values (p_k = 1 - Phi(Z_k)) are the single-look unadjusted tail areas required to cross the boundary at stage k (0.0015, 0.0162, 0.0436). In contrast, cumulative alpha spent (alpha*(t_k)) represents the total probability of false rejection accumulated up to stage k under the continuous Lan-DeMets spending function (0.0007, 0.0164, 0.0500). Conflating nominal boundary p-values with alpha spent is a common reporting error that this implementation resolves.
statistical_design_verification.total_type_I_error_guarantee: Overall family-wise false positive rate is strictly bounded at alpha <= 0.0500.
statistical_design_verification.peeking_ban: Unplanned significance testing between scheduled interim looks is strictly prohibited.
